text_layer_trustworthy.instructions: The page has a real embedded text layer created with the document (not an OCR layer over an image, not garbled), whose text can be used directly without OCR.

mostly_handwritten.instructions: Most of the page content is handwritten. A printed form filled in by hand, or a printed page with handwritten notes, marks or signatures, is not.

camera_or_fax.instructions: The page image is a camera photo of a physical page or a fax. A flatbed scan, a screenshot or a digital render is neither.

heavily_degraded.instructions: The page image is degraded enough to plausibly hurt a standard OCR engine: blur or low resolution that makes characters soft or merged, heavy noise, fading, stains, low contrast, uneven lighting or shadows, or warping.

capture_defects.instructions: The page image has defects that make some characters harder to read: photocopy artefacts (blotchy, broken or dithered strokes), bleed-through from the reverse side, curved or warped paper, heavy speckle, or faded or broken characters. Light speckle, a paper tint, light banding, a faint watermark, faint show-through or light copy grain behind crisp text do not count.

complex_layout.instructions: The page has tables, equations, source code, or two or more text columns.

has_table.instructions: The page contains at least one table.

has_math.instructions: The page contains mathematical equations or notation.

has_code.instructions: The page contains source code or a configuration listing.

is_form.instructions: The page is a form with labelled fields or boxes to fill in.

has_handwriting.instructions: The page contains any handwriting: notes, signatures, filled-in fields or handwritten text.

degradation.instructions: How degraded is the page image for text recognition?
criteria: Mild: slight noise, tint or softness
Heavy: photo distortion, fax or photocopy artefacts, bleed-through, strong noise or fading
Severe: large parts hard to read

continues_previous.instructions: This page's text (`embedded_text_sample`) continues the same table, list or sentence that ends `previous_page_text_sample`.

lanes.L4: degraded scan, camera photo or fax
